subtitle: Deploying robotic systems from the Arctic to the Antarctic

expeditions.title: ROV Survey of Whale Bones
expeditions.text: ROV survey studying the ecological significance of subsistence whale remains. Imagery used to construct and label 3D models and detect changes over time.

expeditions.title: Sea Ice Survey from USCGC Healy
expeditions.text: Led ROV survey of freshly forming pancake sea ice aboard the Icebreaker Healy, collecting imagery and telemetry to analyze structural properties of Arctic sea ice.

expeditions.title: ROV Minerva — Shipwreck Mapping
expeditions.text: Integrated multi-camera rig with inertial sensing on ROV Minerva to inspect subsea infrastructure and the shipwreck Hercules in the Trondheim fjord.

expeditions.title: Arctic Glacier Front Mapping
expeditions.text: ASV field operations mapping Kongsbreen and Blomstranda glaciers to detect changes at active calving fronts.

expeditions.title: Antarctic Sea-Ice Study (DEFiANT)
expeditions.text: Designed camera units and software for the British Antarctic Survey's DEFiANT program, studying variability of Antarctic sea ice from aircraft.

expeditions.title: DARPA Robotics Challenge
expeditions.text: Sensor integration and control software for Boston Dynamics' Atlas humanoid at IHMC. Team placed 2nd in the competition.
